description: This is a Java test class for the BusinessDateWritePlatformService, containing unit tests for updating and increasing business dates, utilizing Mockito for mocking dependencies and JUnit for testing assertions.

classes.name: BusinessDateWritePlatformServiceTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class utilizing Mockito to verify behavior of BusinessDateWritePlatformService, specifically testing date updates and increment logic.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets a tenant context before each test execution.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets tenant context after each test execution.

methods.name: businessDateIsNotEnabled
methods.description: Tests that attempting to update the business date when the feature is disabled throws an exception.

methods.name: businessDateSetNew
methods.description: Tests setting a new business date when none exists for the specified type.

methods.name: cobDateSetNew
methods.description: Tests setting a new COB date when none exists for COB_DATE.

methods.name: businessDateSetModifyExistingWhenItWasAfter
methods.description: Tests updating an existing business date when the new date is before the current date.

methods.name: businessDateSetModifyExistingWhenItWasBefore
methods.description: Tests updating an existing business date when the new date is after the current date.

methods.name: businessDateSetModifyExistingButNoChanges
methods.description: Verifies that no save occurs if the updated date is the same as the existing date.

methods.name: cobDateSetNewAutomatically
methods.description: Tests automatic setting of COB date along with Business date when COB adjustment is enabled.

methods.name: businessDateAndCobDateSetModifyExistingButNoChanges
methods.description: Tests no update when both Business and COB dates are unchanged.

methods.name: businessDateIsNotEnabledTriggeredByJob
methods.description: Ensures that an exception is thrown if a job attempts to modify dates when the feature is disabled.

methods.name: businessDateSetNewTriggeredByJob
methods.description: Verifies automatic increment of Business and COB dates by one day during a job process.

methods.name: cobDateModifyExistingTriggeredByJob
methods.description: Tests incrementing an existing COB date during a job process.
